ladder.label: TOPPING
ladder.why: Daily momentum just crossed down and price lost its 10-day average mid-cycle.
ladder.next: Trim or tighten stops; next likely support is the daily-cycle timing band (~day 36-42, now day 21).
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum positive (investor cycle week 9 · daily cycle day 21).
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)

entry.text: Momentum rolled over and the 10-day average is lost — reduce or tighten stops.
entry.text_zh: 动量已掉头向下且失守 10 日均线——减仓或收紧止损。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 21 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 21 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 9 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 9 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 日线动量刚刚向下交叉，且价格在周期中段失守 10 日均线。
ladder.next_zh: 减仓或收紧止损；下一个可能的支撑是日线周期的时间窗口 （约第 36-42 天，现为第 21 天）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量为正（投资者周期第 9 周 · 日线周期第 21 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：做顶中。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
日线动量刚刚向下交叉
ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ TOPPING signal triggered 2 trading days ago (~2026-06-10), switching from NEARING A LOW. Signal strength: moderate (score -40/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 做顶中信号于 2 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-10），自接近低点切换而来。 信号强度：中等（评分 -40/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱卖出/离场形态（-21）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

profile.description: Veeva Systems Inc., headquartered in Pleasanton, California, provides cloud computing software, data, and consulting services for the life sciences industry. Its products are used to track all aspects of drug development and pharmaceutical manufacturing.
profile.description_zh: Veeva Systems Inc.（Veeva系统公司）总部位于加利福尼亚州普莱森顿，为生命科学行业提供云计算软件、数据和咨询服务，其产品用于追踪药物研发和制药制造的各个环节。
